rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, 1993).
Introduced in France by Globe Planter as 'Contrex'.
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2007 as 'UNICEF-Rose'.
rows.Bloom: Salmon-pink. None / no fragrance. Average diameter 2". Small to medium, semi-double (9-16 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, spreading. Medium, glossy foliage.

Height: 31" to 47" (80 to 120cm). Width: 28" to 4'7" (70 to 140cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for ground cover or landscape. Disease susceptibility: very blackspot resistant., very mildew resistant.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
